idea-plugin.name: Logcat2Kt
idea-plugin.description: Offline Logcat to collapsible JSON and Kotlin data classes, based on rendonglugit/logcat2kt (MIT). Supports truncated logs, Kotlin/Java toString, Protobuf text and hex, Gson/Moshi/kotlinx annotations. Open Logcat2Kt from the right tool window stripe. Android Studio 2025.1.1 and later (platform 251+). Native UI; no JCEF, network connection, Kotlin plugin or Android plugin dependency required.

action.description: 将选中的日志发送到 Logcat2Kt 并打开右侧工具窗口
